name: Microsoft Outlook AI Email Assistant with contact support from Monday and Airtable
description: An AI-powered assistant for Outlook that processes emails, sanitizes content, and assigns categories using rules from Airtable. Integrates with Monday.com for contact support.

"Loop Over Items" uses NodeLoop: process each item/batch, return through NEXT, and continue only after all results are collected.

Select the Project and Environment on the Workflow Configs node (the ids from `cdecli auth status`), then connect a credential for each connector below.
Connect airtable: `cdecli credential create -n "airtable" -p airtable --template <formId> --secret <key>=<value>` (see `cdecli credential templates`).
Connect googlesuper: `cdecli credential create -n "googlesuper" -p googlesuper --template <formId> --secret <key>=<value>` (see `cdecli credential templates`).
Connect monday: `cdecli credential create -n "monday" -p monday --template <formId> --secret <key>=<value>` (see `cdecli credential templates`).

notes:
## Outlook Business with filters
Filters:
```
flag/flagStatus eq 'notFlagged' and not categories/any()
```

These filters ensure we do not process flagged emails or email that already have a category set.

## Sanitise Email 
Removes HTML and useless information in preparation for the AI Agent

## Get Rules & Categories
Edit the airtables to set your own categories, rules, contacts and/or delete rules.

## CRM Contact List Integration 
For this workflow I am retrieving supplier & client contacts from Monday.com the email assistant has better context to categorise, prioritise and reply to emails.
The list is updated daily or you can change the scheduler trigger to update more or less frequently.
You could replace this with your own CRM.
## Set the category & importance using the output from the agent

## Match Contact
Check if the sender is an existing contact. Note in this workflow the contacts are dynamically loaded from Monday.com
